description: Opaque burgundy-purple floor-length gown over a cream underdress, with a low square neckline and structured fitted bodice. Rich gold floral-geometric woven borders decorate the neckline, vertical bodice strips, sleeves and hem. Short outer sleeves are fastened with small round gold clasps over cream elbow-length inner sleeves. A narrow belt has round gold ornaments and long chain-ended ties. A matching purple wrap rests over the forearms and hangs at either side with broad gold borders. Cream underdress shows at the lower front opening. Gold earrings, bracelet and patterned closed shoes accompany it. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
